# Finch McCranie LLP

> Atlanta-based trial law firm specializing in personal injury, white-collar criminal defense, whistleblower representation, and complex commercial litigation.

Finch McCranie LLP is a full-service law firm with offices in Atlanta and Duluth, Georgia, founded by Baxter Finch and Claude Ross. The firm represents clients in high-stakes litigation including personal injury cases, federal criminal defense, SEC enforcement matters, and False Claims Act/qui tam whistleblower actions.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury
- White-Collar Crime
- Whistleblower & Qui Tam
- False Claims Act
- Securities Enforcement
- SEC & FINRA
- Medical Malpractice
- Wrongful Death
- Federal Criminal Defense
- Complex Commercial Litigation
- Internal Investigations
- Compliance Monitorships
- Atlanta & Duluth, Georgia
- Free Consultation
- Motor Vehicle Accidents
